name: sss
description: Personal skill bundle. jira-ticket: Story/Task/Bug tickets in the hyrd Jira (MAMAS). release-readiness: read-only report on the next release. config-schema: audit a repo's env-var reads and emit a config schema with devDefault, a generated .env.example and fail-fast assertions. dev-local: make a fresh worktree bootable — ports owned by portless, a refusing preflight, and a Liveness Proof. autoship, delegate-tickets and setup-cursor-worker drive autonomous implementation via Orca workers.
